question: Should unconfigured memorySearch.sync.intervalMinutes become a default-on 30-minute fallback for existing users, or should periodic memory sync remain opt-in?
rationale: This changes upgrade behavior for existing users by adding background rescans and possible indexing/provider work, which repository policy treats as a maintainer product and compatibility decision.

options.title: Approve default-on after repair
options.body: Accept the 30-minute default once the dirty-state bug is fixed and upgrade behavior is called out clearly.

options.title: Keep periodic sync opt-in
options.body: Preserve the `0` default and document `intervalMinutes: 30` as the workaround or doctor recommendation for watcher failures.

options.title: Defer to a broader watcher policy
options.body: Pause this PR until the remaining watcher/default policy issues are resolved together with the open gateway watch-default discussion.

recommendation.title: Approve default-on after repair
recommendation.body: Accept the 30-minute default once the dirty-state bug is fixed and upgrade behavior is called out clearly.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory-index and release work makes this the best available owner for the default/upgrade call.
